title: Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho (UGM) Presents Smart Farming Innovation for Sustainable Food Security at Polbangtan Bogor 2026 National Seminar

body:
**Bogor, June 24, 2026** – Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, Lecturer in Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), participated as keynote speaker at the 8th Dies Natalis National Seminar of Politeknik Pembangunan Pertanian (Polbangtan) Bogor. The event, held in hybrid format (Zoom and YouTube), addressed a crucial theme: "Smart Farming as a Strategy for Sustainable Food Self-Sufficiency", aligned with the national effort to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) No. 2: Zero Hunger and No. 13: Climate Action.

In his presentation titled _"Smart Farming Innovation and Agriculture 4.0: Intelligent Agriculture as a Strategy for Sustainable Food Self-Sufficiency"_, Dr. Andri emphasized that modern agriculture must transform by integrating digital technology to address complex challenges such as climate change, resource constraints, and increasing food demand. He explained how **Smart Farming**, through the application of IoT, AI, and big data, can increase production efficiency, reduce waste, and build climate resilience.

Dr. Andri also shared concrete examples of smart farming implementation that have been developed at UGM, such as sensor-based soil monitoring systems, precision irrigation, and the use of drones for land mapping. "This technology is not just about sophisticated tools, but about how we empower farmers with smarter data and decisions," he said.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/826-1-image-1-1030x711.webp)

The seminar was attended by more than 500 participants, including students, agricultural practitioners, and policymakers. The interactive discussion, moderated by Dr. Reni, raised various critical questions, such as the challenges of technology adoption on fragmented land and the integration of smart farming with conventional agricultural infrastructure. Dr. Andri responded with practical solutions, such as a phased approach, collaboration with Gapoktan, and the importance of synergy between technology, infrastructure, and farmer institutions.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/826-2-image-2-1030x572.webp)

Dr. Andri's participation in this seminar not only strengthened UGM's position as a center for tropical agricultural innovation, but also inspired participants to become agents of change in Indonesia's agricultural transformation. "Smart Farming is the key to realizing sustainable food self-sufficiency, but it must go hand in hand with farmer empowerment and supportive policies," Dr. Andri concluded.

**About Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho** Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho is a Lecturer in Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems at UGM, as well as lead researcher at the Smart Agriculture Research Center. He has published dozens of research papers on the integration of digital technology in tropical agriculture and actively contributes to various national and international forums.

original.body:
**Bogor, 24 Juni 2026** – Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, Dosen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem dari Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), berpartisipasi sebagai narasumber utama dalam Seminar Nasional Dies Natalis ke-8 Politeknik Pembangunan Pertanian (Polbangtan) Bogor. Acara yang diselenggarakan secara hybrid (Zoom dan YouTube) ini mengangkat tema krusial: “Smart Farming sebagai Strategi Swasembada Pangan Berkelanjutan”, sejalan dengan upaya nasional untuk mencapai Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (SDGs) No. 2: Tanpa Kelaparan (Zero Hunger) dan No. 13: Tindakan Iklim (Climate Action).

Dalam presentasinya berjudul _“Inovasi Smart Farming dan Agriculture 4.0: Pertanian Cerdas sebagai Strategi Swasembada Pangan Berkelanjutan”_, Dr. Andri menekankan bahwa pertanian modern harus bertransformasi dengan mengintegrasikan teknologi digital untuk mengatasi tantangan kompleks seperti perubahan iklim, keterbatasan sumber daya, dan kebutuhan pangan yang terus meningkat. Beliau menjelaskan bagaimana **Smart Farming**, melalui penerapan IoT, AI, dan big data, dapat meningkatkan efisiensi produksi, mengurangi limbah, dan membangun ketahanan iklim.

Dr. Andri juga membagikan contoh konkret implementasi smart farming yang telah dikembangkan di UGM, seperti sistem pemantauan tanah berbasis sensor, irigasi presisi, dan penggunaan drone untuk pemetaan lahan. “Teknologi ini bukan hanya tentang alat canggih, tetapi tentang bagaimana kita memberdayakan petani dengan data dan keputusan yang lebih cerdas,” ujarnya.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/826-1-image-1-1030x711.webp)

Seminar ini dihadiri oleh lebih dari 500 peserta, termasuk mahasiswa, praktisi pertanian, dan pemangku kebijakan. Diskusi interaktif yang dimoderatori oleh Dr. Reni mengungkap berbagai pertanyaan kritis, seperti tantangan adopsi teknologi di lahan terfragmentasi dan integrasi smart farming dengan infrastruktur pertanian konvensional. Dr. Andri merespons dengan solusi praktis, seperti pendekatan bertahap, kolaborasi dengan Gapoktan, dan pentingnya sinergi antara teknologi, infrastruktur, dan kelembagaan petani.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/826-2-image-2-1030x572.webp)

Partisipasi Dr. Andri dalam seminar ini tidak hanya memperkuat posisi UGM sebagai pusat inovasi pertanian tropis, tetapi juga menginspirasi peserta untuk menjadi agen perubahan dalam transformasi pertanian Indonesia. “Smart Farming adalah kunci untuk mewujudkan swasembada pangan yang berkelanjutan, tetapi harus berjalan bersama dengan pemberdayaan petani dan kebijakan yang mendukung,” tutup Dr. Andri.

**Tentang Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho** Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho adalah Dosen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem di UGM, sekaligus peneliti utama di Smart Agriculture Research Center. Beliau telah menerbitkan puluhan penelitian tentang integrasi teknologi digital dalam pertanian tropis dan aktif berkontribusi dalam berbagai forum nasional dan internasional.
